objective: Implement Ruling D54, the team is the profile's. The code ships no team, and every prompt renders from the active profile's framing. The engineering team moves unchanged into profiles/engineering.yaml, which renders every prompt byte-identical to main's. A neutral profiles/general.yaml becomes the default. Triage is offered the active profile's vocabulary only. Free work; no paid call.
evidence: Ruling D54, signed off by the owner on 2026-10-21 as written: docs/reviews/2026-10-21-d54-the-team-is-the-profiles.md. §1 lists every site, §2 is the ruling, §3 the proofs, §4 the default change.

The profile mechanism this builds on: autornd/profiles.py (ProjectProfile, domains, roles, structural_roles, role_that_checks_work, role_that_holds_system_view; B14) and profiles/studio.yaml (a team that is not engineering).
Golden-prompt precedent: tests/test_recompute_vote.py TestGoldenPrompts (command 123), which captured rendered prompts from the pre-change code.

The live role-injection path: autornd/engine/phases.py lines 120-145 (the profile's structural roles). engine/workflow.py _enforce_triage_composition is called only by tests/test_review_composition.py TestTriageEnforcement.

include: autornd/profiles.py: the framing block, base:, the general default, loading
profiles/example.yaml, profiles/cupline.yaml, profiles/tier4.yaml: base: engineering, with their comments updated to match

autornd/engine/phases.py, autornd/knowledge/context.py, autornd/knowledge/research.py, autornd/specialists/registry.py, autornd/engine/review_composition.py, autornd/graph/adapter.py, autornd/engine/workflow.py: every site in D54 §1
autornd/models/verdicts.py: only if needed. The Domain and SpecialistRole classes may stay as types
evals/tier3/ and evals/tier4/ runners: only to select the engineering base for their treatments, so every message they send stays byte-identical
tests/conftest.py: the AUTORND_PROFILE placeholder becomes engineering
tests/test_profile_framing.py (new), plus golden fixtures under tests/fixtures/
.env.example: AUTORND_PROFILE= with a comment saying empty means general and engineering means the engineering team
README.md, HANDOVER.md, AGENTS.md: the profile text and the counts
exclude: workflows/*.yaml: unchanged, names included. Whether to rename engineering-rnd belongs to the workflow-per-request ruling
The tier names in autornd/config.py (MODEL_ENGINEERING and the rest): unchanged. They are job names in config, not prompt text
evals/ frozen data: batches, keys, scorers, corpora
autornd/database.py: no schema change. If one is needed, STOP and report

constraints: FREE. No paid call. Every test is provider-free, and the network guard stays at 0.

GOLDEN FIRST: the branch's first commit, before any other change, captures from main's code the rendered system and user message of every prompt in D54 §1. That means run_triage, run_asks, run_plan, run_plan_feasibility, build_domain_review_prompt, run_implement (with and without results), run_recompute, run_validate, run_review, run_doublecheck, run_escalation_autopsy, the context.py ranking, query-expansion, briefing, rerank and request-scoping prompts, the research lookup, and every shipped role's system prompt from specialists/registry.py. Capture them on fixed representative inputs, as fixtures.

FRAMING: the profile's framing block has team, work, practitioner, sources, deliverables and examples (D54 §2 (2)). You may add a field when a prompt needs a word those six do not carry. Name each added field in deviations. No field holds a whole prompt.

ENGINEERING IS UNCHANGED: under profiles/engineering.yaml, and under example, cupline and tier4 (base: engineering), every captured prompt renders byte-identical to its fixture. engineering.yaml declares today's seven domains in today's order, with today's lenses and leads, today's seven role templates, and structural_roles checks_work: test_engineer and holds_system_view: systems_architect.

GENERAL RENDERING: under general, each prompt is its engineering rendering with each framing value substituted. No sentence is added. A sentence whose content is only an engineering example (the pasteuriser, partition and interlock sentence; ERP and EIRP) lives in examples, and is absent under general. A clause that offers a list the profile does not have (triage's 'Prefer these: …' with no subjects or roles) is omitted, and the 'name it yourself' sentence stays. List every omitted clause and every grammar fix-up in deviations.

GENERAL PROFILE, verbatim: team 'a team'; work 'the work'; practitioner 'a competent practitioner in the field'; sources 'primary sources: the governing rules and standards, official specifications, and original publications'; no domains; no examples. Its roles: lead {name 'Lead', tier engineering, expertise 'Does the work the request asks for, in full.'}; reviewer {name 'Reviewer', tier engineering, expertise 'Checks the work against what the request asked, and names what is wrong or missing.'}; planner {name 'Planner', tier architecture, expertise 'Holds the whole view: what the request needs, in what order, and what it depends on.'}. structural_roles: checks_work reviewer, holds_system_view planner. deliverables 'the document, the plan, the procedure, the analysis, the calculation'.
TRIAGE VOCABULARY: triage is offered the active profile's domains and roles only. Shipped defaults are never added on top. Under engineering that is today's lists in today's order.

STRUCTURAL ROLES: the plan and feasibility steps take their architect from profile.role_that_holds_system_view(). The validate persona is profile.role_that_checks_work(). The builder filter in graph/adapter.py and the fallback lead compare against the profile's roles, not the shipped literals.

BASE: a profile may declare base: <profile name>. The base's framing, domains, roles and structural_roles apply, and the profile's own declarations replace the base's under the same key. One level only: a base that declares a base is refused with a plain error naming both.

DEFAULT: AUTORND_PROFILE unset loads profiles/general.yaml. A profile that declares no framing gets general's framing, and one that declares no structural roles gets general's (D54 §2 (6)), unless its base supplies them. A named profile that does not exist keeps today's behaviour: a warning, then the default, which is now general.

DEAD CODE: engine/workflow.py _enforce_triage_composition has no production caller. Remove it and the five TestTriageEnforcement tests, and name in the response the live-path tests that cover the same two rules. If you find a production caller, STOP and report it.

EVALS: the tier-3 and tier-4 runners' treatments must not change. Their process-default and per-question profiles take base: engineering. If any frozen treatment's message would change, STOP and report which.
THE SUITE: in tests/conftest.py PLACEHOLDERS, AUTORND_PROFILE is 'engineering', so the existing tests keep running on the engineering team. New tests select general or studio explicitly.
NEVER PARSE ENGLISH: nothing routes on a framing value. Framing is text that is rendered, never tested.
A defect found in existing harness code while doing this is a STOP-and-report, not a fix.
acceptance_criteria: (a) Golden. The fixtures are the branch's first commit, captured from main's code. Under engineering, example, cupline and tier4, every fixture's prompt renders byte-identical. Break-proof: change one framing value in engineering.yaml and the test fails.

(b) No leak. Run every workflow in workflows/ end to end behind a recording double (route every prompt, including the grounding, research and recompute prompts), under general and under studio. Scan every system and user message sent, case-insensitively, for: engineer, engineers, engineering, firmware, hardware, backend, frontend, datasheet, datasheets, pasteuriser, EIRP. None appears. Studio's own declared text is exempt only where studio declared it. Break-proof: put 'engineering' back into the triage prompt and the test fails.

(c) Triage vocabulary. Under studio, the offered subjects and roles are exactly studio's. Under general, none, the 'Prefer these' clauses are absent, and 'name it yourself' is present. Under engineering, today's lists. Break-proof: add the shipped Domain members back and the studio test fails.

(d) Structural roles. Under studio, high risk adds editor, multiple subjects add strategist, the plan's system prompt is the strategist's, and validate's is the editor's. Under general the same with reviewer and planner. Under engineering, today's. Each has a break-proof.

(e) No literals. A test scans autornd/ for code references to SpecialistRole.<MEMBER> and Domain.<MEMBER>, and expects none outside autornd/models/verdicts.py. Break-proof: a reference added to phases.py fails it.
(f) Default and base. With AUTORND_PROFILE unset, get_profile() is general. base: engineering lays a profile's own keys over engineering's. A base with a base is refused with the plain error.
(g) Evals unchanged. The tier-3 and tier-4 runners' existing message-hash and freeze tests pass unmodified.

(h) Docs. .env.example carries AUTORND_PROFILE= with its comment. The README's profile and roster text says general is the default and engineering is a profile, and its guards in tests/test_docs.py pass (the roster guard checks against the engineering profile's roles). Counts are re-derived from pytest --collect-only in HANDOVER.md, README.md and AGENTS.md.
(i) Suite green before and after, network guard 0, CI 5/5, PR opened. Every existing test passes unmodified except the five removed under DEAD CODE.

verification.expected: All pass; network guard: 0; report the count before and after.

rollback: Revert the PR. With AUTORND_PROFILE=engineering, behaviour is unchanged by construction (criterion (a)).
deliverable: One PR with the golden fixtures as its first commit, the profiles, the framing in every prompt site, the tests with their break-proofs, the docs and counts, and the response marked DONE. Then STOP.
assumptions: Every prompt in D54 §1 can render from profile fields without changing its engineering bytes. If one cannot, STOP and report it with the bytes that would change.
